notes.title: VERSION 3.0: THE POWERFUL AND COLORFUL UPDATE
notes.notes:
THE POWERFUL AND COLORFUL UPDATE

Hi everyone!

I’m excited to share another update for this long-running game, and this one brings some major game-changers!

What’s New?


 [NEW] Added a new Game Boy Color-inspired color mode, complete with a custom border and screen effects.
 
 [NEW] Added localization for French, Portuguese, German, Italian, and Japanese. The Japanese version uses only Hiragana + Katakana (no complex kanji) to mimic classic handheld console games.
 
 [NEW] New lore-related items tied to this universe—hinting at connections to an upcoming game.
 
 [NEW] By popular demand, the pause menu now includes an option to quit directly to the title screen (and exit the app).
 
 [NEW] Revamped the main menu with additional settings for better customization.



Bug Fixes


 [FIXED] Patched a memory leak that caused the game’s RAM usage to gradually increase.
 
 [FIXED] Fixed a bug that broke the fishing minigame mechanics.
 
 [FIXED] Full controller compatibility is now 100% stable.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: POCKET PENGUIN DX!
notes.notes:
Hi!!
It's been a couple of years since the launch of Pocket Penguin and it's been very complicated years for everyone.
Fortunately the conditions have improved and with it we also have very good news.
We have not forgotten the support that has been given to the game. From the purchases to the streamers who have played it and that's why we want to inform you that a big update is coming to the game.
This update contains new mini-games, the ability to choose difficulty mode, new palettes (a total of 19), full support for controls, and the ability to change the resolution. There are few changes that feels like a new game. We hope you like them.
We leave you a photo to see the radical change that the game now has.
These updates will be coming very soon, so take advantage of the summer offer!
